hero-idle.prompt: Image 1 is the exact accepted blue-caped hero identity and pixel art master. Image 2 is a scale-and-root template made from this same character. Produce EXACT 2 rows x 4 columns, eight frames, row-major. Preserve Image 2 cell locations, camera distance, anatomical scale, grounded body root, boot-contact baseline at 82% cell height and padding. Torso/head/limb thickness/costume/crossbow dimensions constant. Same three-quarter upper-right facing, chestnut hair, warm face, blue cape, dark navy armor and bronze trim, wooden cyan-rune crossbow. Both feet stay LOCKED to the exact same spots in every frame. Only posed joints and fabric may move, no entire body translation or rotation, no zoom, no mirrored frames. Body-only animation: no muzzle flash, no projectile, no detached FX. Whole silhouette stays central 70% of each cell and no part touches any cell edge. Background solid #FF00FF, no shadow no text no labels no UI no grid. Eight-frame subtle BREATHING IDLE loop. Same crossbow aim and both arms held stable; only 1-2 source pixels of chest breathing, soft blue cape fabric ripple through 8 evenly spaced phases. Head and pelvis fixed. Frames 1 and 8 connect smoothly. Avoid changing costume/cape length or hair shape. Not a walk and not a bobbing whole-body idle.

hero-shoot.prompt: Image 1 is the exact accepted blue-caped hero identity and pixel art master. Image 2 is a scale-and-root template made from this same character. Produce EXACT 2 rows x 4 columns, eight frames, row-major. Preserve Image 2 cell locations, camera distance, anatomical scale, grounded body root, boot-contact baseline at 82% cell height and padding. Torso/head/limb thickness/costume/crossbow dimensions constant. Same three-quarter upper-right facing, chestnut hair, warm face, blue cape, dark navy armor and bronze trim, wooden cyan-rune crossbow. Both feet stay LOCKED to the exact same spots in every frame. Only posed joints and fabric may move, no entire body translation or rotation, no zoom, no mirrored frames. Frame2 brace elbow subtly. Frame3 trigger finger release with almost unchanged bow position. Frame4 small recoil in shoulder and bow only, 2-3 source pixels, feet/head/pelvis fixed. projectiles.prompt: One production sprite atlas of 8 fantasy projectile sprites, exact 2 rows x 4 columns equal square invisible cells, row-major. Crisp pixel art, clean distinct silhouettes, dark edge and bright colored core, no overblown glow. All traveling RIGHT, nose at right, short attached trail to left. Centered each inside central 65%, generous margin all four sides. Background pure solid #FF00FF, no text no labels no borders no UI no characters. Row1: bronze rune crossbow bolt with steel pointed tip and cyan small rune, elongated horizontal; orange cream-core fireball with short flame tail; cyan white-core ice lance horizontal diamond spearhead and shaft; gray-brown chunky rolling stone with 3 broad facets and tiny dust curl. Row2: curved silver teal spinning crescent wind blade, circular compact; orange-red cracked rocky meteor with short flaming tail pointing left; mint-green little flying spirit with leaf ears, two eyes and short tail, facing right; dark red-purple enemy magic orb with bright red core and small sparking outline. Consistent optical size suitable rendering 18-48px, restrained particle count, no background gradients.

impacts.prompt: One production pixel-art battle VFX animation atlas, EXACT 4 rows x 4 columns, 16 equal cells. Each row is ONE effect animated through four timed phases left-to-right: small onset, strongest compact contact, expanding airy fragments, fading sparse remnants. Row1 warm cream-gold weapon HIT SPARK, star contact into short shards. Row2 orange FIRE EXPLOSION, cream core into orange flame petals and embers. Row3 cyan ICE SHATTER, bright crystalline contact into sharp ice fragments. Row4 violet ELECTRIC IMPACT, white-violet star into forked purple lightning wisps. Keep center fixed in each cell; optical radius grows naturally by phase, all effect silhouettes contained central 70% with generous pure #FF00FF margin on every side, no effect overlaps adjacent cell. Crisp pixels, clear tone groups and transparent-to-be-cut spaces between sparks, NOT opaque giant discs, no fog/cloud cover, no heavy glow halos. No text no labels no borders no UI no characters. These will overlay monsters without hiding their bodies.

grounds.prompt: One production pixel-art ground magic VFX atlas, EXACT 2 rows x 4 columns equal square invisible cells. Row1 FOUR continuous loop phases of orange low ground flames, small flame tongues around a thin elliptical ember ring, center mostly open, ground scorch dark only in ring. Row2 FOUR continuous loop phases of cyan snow magic field, thin elliptical icy rune ring, small ice crystals and three delicate drifting snow specks, center mostly open. View from slightly above matches topdown fantasy road. Same ellipse size, fixed center per cell, only flame tongues/snow crystals/rune pulse animate; first/last join smoothly. Subdued transparent-to-be-cut empty centers and gaps, no opaque colorful blanket. All art fits central 70% of each cell with generous pure flat #FF00FF margin on all four sides. Pixel art crisp, no text no labels no UI no visible grid no characters no platforms.

talents.prompt: Use the twelve skill icon atlas just shown as the exact pixel-art STYLE reference, not layout. Create a matching supplemental icon atlas, EXACT 2 rows x 2 columns equal square cells. Four distinct passive ability icons: top-left REPAIR, a small stone battlement and bronze hammer with one mint healing cross; top-right POWER, raised armored bronze fist and small gold star; bottom-left RAPID RELOAD, compact bronze crossbow plus cyan circular speed arrow; bottom-right CRITICAL INSIGHT, a gold eye with a small red diamond target in the pupil. All icons bold readable at 28-48px, crisp dark outline, clear 3-5 tone groups, coherent with reference palette, centered in central 65-70% of each cell, generous magenta margin on all four sides, NO icon frame borders NO grid NO text NO labels NO UI. Entire canvas background solid #FF00FF.
